jobs.title: Senior Designer
jobs.description: About Tangible Tangible Markets builds secondary market infrastructure for private fund LP interests. Our platforms help investors, wealth managers, fund managers and lenders buy, sell, price, finance and close secondary transactions. Our products: Liquidity Hub: a secondary marketplace where LPs list fund interests and qualified buyers bid, with liquidity windows, tender offers and NAV lending. Auctions: a competitive sale process for fund interests, supported by pricing models, pricing reports and market sentiment data. Closing Platform: a transaction workflow built with a leading law firm to manage transfer documents, signatures and closing steps. The role You own the design of our products end to end, from research to shipped UI. You work with product, engineering and data teams on complex financial workflows used by institutional buyers, wealth advisors, lenders, fund managers and lawyers. Several products run as white-label versions for large financial partners. Position open to candidates based in the EU and the UK. Responsibilities Own visual branding and design direction across every product, with a modern and consistent standard. Lead the UX and UI revamp across the whole platform. Design end-to-end flows across all products: onboarding, listings, bidding, pricing, financing and closing. Turn complex financial and legal processes into clear, simple interfaces. Design data-dense screens: pricing outputs, dashboards, reports, tables and comparisons. Run user research and usability testing with buyers, sellers, advisors and partners. Own the design system across products and white-label client versions. Own the design process, including where AI tools fit to speed up research, prototyping and production. Own design organization: files, handoff, and how work moves from design to build. Set the quality bar and hold it. Nothing ships that has not cleared it. Direct the product designer and review their output. Work with engineering through build and QA so design
